description.value:
This shield was forged in the ancient smithies of Eregion by the people of Celebrimbor before that land was laid waste by the Enemy. It is crafted from the wood of a thindolvorn tree—a rare cedar native to Lindon and Beleriand known for its resilience—and is reinforced with hair-thin veins of Mithril-steel. The face of the shield is inlaid with Ithildin, depicting a host of stars that remain dormant until touched by starlight or the proper Elvish words.

  • Item Type: Shield
  • Craftsmanship: Elven (Eregion)
  • Bane: Orcs

Qualities

As a Famous piece of war gear, its qualities are unlocked as the hero’s VALOUR increases or by visiting a treasury.

  1. Ancient Cunning Make (Enchanted Reward): The shield is preternaturally light. Its Load rating is lowered by 3 points, or by the wielder's VALOUR rating, whichever is higher (to a minimum of 0 Load).
  2. Reinforced (Standard Reward): The Mithril reinforcement makes the structure incredibly sturdy, adding +1 to the shield’s Parry bonus.
  3. Superior Reinforced (Enchanted Reward): The shield seems to move of its own accord to intercept blows. This adds an additional +2 to the Parry bonus. Because it is a weapon of Elven craftsmanship, when the bearer is fighting their Bane (Orcs), this quality instead adds a bonus equal to 1 plus the bearer's VALOUR rank.

Combined Combat Stats

  • Load: 1 (or 0 if the bearer has VALOUR 4+).
  • Parry Bonus: +5 (+2 base, +1 Reinforced, +2 Superior Reinforced).
  • Parry Bonus vs. Orcs: +3 + (1 + VALOUR). For a hero with VALOUR 3, this shield provides a massive +7 bonus to Parry against Orcs.
